Amazon’s total revenue in fiscal year 2024 is reported as “Net sales” in its Consolidated Statements of Operations.

From the FY2024 Form 10-K:  
- “Net sales, fiscal year 2024: $637,959” (in millions) [DOC-1]

Since the figure is in millions of dollars, this corresponds to $637,959 million, or $637.959 billion.

ANSWER: $637.959 billion
